# true60 N-step spec (not a gate unit: units/_t60/ is left out of verify_all and the game build's unit list)
include d_a_esa.txt
# ---- true60 N-step spec (generated by tools/t60conv 2026-11-18): the execute path on a general step length; callees are mocks
# (the same answer on every step and on the one step). Timers / flags / modes exact; t60tol lines below only for
# float rounding of inline integration sites (tool tolerance loop, each listed in the tool report).
t60conv 021300C4
# steering (hand): bg_check's wall line test runs on every step (the per-step ground-check rule: a step
# samples the wall at its own position; the reflection is a per-step event, proven by the pairs). The mock answers the
# same on every step, so a hit would reflect on every step (twice at N 2) where the one step reflects once: no wall hit.
ret! 02008860 0
# the ground / water tests in bg_check run on every step too (the per-step ground-check rule: each step snaps to the ground at its own
# position, so N steps legitimately land on another step than the one step; pairs and plausibility cover it). The
# flight is checked off the ground: the ground far below, no sea area, no water. The landing reaction gate (st != 0 on
# the first step) is still exercised: mState comes from the generated input (r3+0x3BD) on the first step.
fret! 02008974 -100000 -100000
ret! 0246B6A4 0
fret! 024F17D4 -1000000000 -1000000000
# the model at a fixed address so its base scale (+0xBC, written from scale.x in act 4) can carry a tolerance
field 021300C4 r3+0x3D8 u32 0x5A000000
# float rounding of the converted steps: pos (v x dt per step, the exact-arc fall term), speed.y (g x dt), the shrink
# (cLib_addCalc0, central ratio form) into scale and the model's base scale
t60tol 021300C4 r3+0x314 f32x3 absrel 0.001 0.00001
t60tol 021300C4 r3+0x340 f32 absrel 0.0001 0.00001
t60tol 021300C4 r3+0x330 f32x3 absrel 0.0001 0.0001
t60tol 021300C4 5A0000BC f32x3 absrel 0.0001 0.0001
# effect calls (sound / particle starts, actor creation; tools/t60conv): as many calls over the N steps as in the one step
t60calls 025A847C
# c_lib eases run their converted (dt-aware) code (t60conv default, 2026-11-20; a mocked or plain-real ease ignores the step dt)
src wwhd_src/SSystem/SComponent/c_lib.cpp
real 0200EDC8
t60cand 0200EDC8
